default/30416.htm.text: Triskel: I am Triskel. Remember that! If you want to become an Assassin, you will have to meet me again someday.

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30416-01.htm.text: Triskel: Assassins are murderers who kill quietly and swiftly, then vanish into the forest. They are also fighters of darkness who are talented in concealment and spying. They target the enemy's weak points with small but convenient weapons like daggers, or shoot arrows from a long distance.

links.text: Say you want to be an Assassin.

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30416-04.htm.text: Triskel: You already have the Iron Heart! You already have the qualifications to become an Assassin! Take the Iron Heart and go to Grand Master Tobias of the Dark Elf Guild to change profession!

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30416-06.html.text: Triskel: O ho, your skills are quite good! So, you received the acknowledgement of Arkenia. Indeed, I have keen insight when it comes to seeing potential. Now take this Iron Heart and go to a Grand Master of the Dark Elf Guild, who will give you what you want. The nearest choice would be to go to G…

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30416-02.htm.text: Triskel: Triskel does not speak with foolish fellows who do not know their profession!

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30416-02a.htm.text: Triskel: Why would one who is already an Assassin want to become an Assassin again? Triskel does not speak with foolish fellows that do not know their profession!

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30416-03.htm.text: Triskel: Hey, you little punk...you want to be an assassin? Go home to your mother! (Only characters level 18 and above may undertake this quest.)

Q00411_PathOfTheAssassin/30416-05.htm.text: Triskel: Hmm ... So the likes of you wants to change profession to an Assassin? Good. As luck would have it, I was just now in need of a nimble fellow. You must know that the foundation of an Assassin is quick movements! Use this opportunity to prove your skills to me! Now take this and go to Arken…
